Select IC50 activity rows for human Indoleamine 2,3-dioxygenase 1. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, assays on assay_id, target_dictionary on tid, docs on doc_id, and compound_structures on molregno (inner join). Filter target_dictionary.pref_name for Indoleamine 2,3-dioxygenase 1 and target_dictionary.organism for Homo sapiens; filter activities.standard_type for IC50. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id, fallback to doi), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all activity rows; do not deduplicate. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
